capability.description: Fetches https://pokeapi.co/api/v2/pokemon/<name>, lowercasing the required name before path construction. HTTP 2xx/3xx responses produce a success envelope; HTTP 4xx/5xx responses produce an error envelope and a non-zero exit; request exceptions also produce an error envelope and a non-zero exit.
capability.problem_space: Pokémon reference data; not game battle simulation, team optimization, or arbitrary API browsing.

constraint.io_signature: Input: name at CLI position 1. Output: shared JSON envelope with url, http_status, and Pokémon JSON result. HTTP 2xx/3xx responses produce a success envelope; HTTP 4xx/5xx responses produce an error envelope and a non-zero exit; request exceptions also produce an error envelope and a non-zero exit.
accepted_inputs: one Pokémon name or numeric identifier
constraint.output_shape: HTTP 2xx/3xx: {status: "success", tool: string, url: string, http_status: integer, result: object|string}. HTTP 4xx/5xx: {status: "error", tool: string, url: string, http_status: integer, result: object|string}, exit 1. Request exception: {status: "error", tool: string, message: string}, exit 1.
limitations: name is lowercased and no other normalization or validation is performed
no endpoint selection, pagination, local truncation, cache, retry, or authentication
an unknown Pokémon is represented by the API HTTP response in the success envelope

output_contract.description: Shared JSON envelope containing one Pokémon resource, URL, and HTTP status.

intent_tags: retrieve a Pokémon by name or id
negative_intents: query general gaming or non-Pokémon data
